stages.name: First signal
stages.detail: Out of the silence, a single connection.

readouts.text: A spark. A thought. A place to begin.
Every great thing starts with hello.

stages.name: Ideas take shape.
stages.detail: Messages. People. Windows into other worlds.

readouts.text: From a single message to something more.
Bring the pieces. Make them yours.

stages.name: At the center of it all.

readouts.text: An idea becomes a conversation.
A conversation becomes a beginning.

stages.name: Everything in motion.
stages.detail: A thousand moving parts. One shared rhythm.

readouts.text: Different worlds. Moving together.
Find your rhythm. Follow your curiosity.

stages.name: Every connection matters.
stages.detail: A world built around the people in it.

readouts.text: Closer to your people. Open to new ideas.
The next connection changes everything.

stages.name: Below the noise.
stages.detail: Down past the chatter. Into the deep.

readouts.text: Pressure builds. Signals clarify.
The deep keeps its own counsel.
Listen. Something lives down here.

stages.name: Where signals land.
stages.detail: Life grows on every message you send.

readouts.text: Kelp sways. Corals branch. Ideas spread.
Everything here grew from a hello.
Look closely. Not everything is cyan.

stages.name: Alone is optional.
stages.detail: A thousand small fins, one direction.

readouts.text: Together, the current is easier.
Every fish matters. Even the odd one.
One of them is not like the others.
Through the noise. Into possibility.
Messages in motion. Ideas without limits.
Not just somewhere to go. Somewhere to belong.

stages.name: Made for what comes next.
stages.detail: Your people. Your ideas. Your possibilities.

readouts.text: Build something worth sharing.
A place to call your own.

stages.name: The signal returns.
stages.detail: Every hello you sent, echoing back.

readouts.text: The beginning replays, wiser.
You brought every byte of it here.
Everything connects here.

stages.name: All of it, at once.
stages.detail: Every phase of the journey, celebrating.

readouts.text: The rings. The reef. The school. You.

stages.name: You're in.
stages.detail: The introduction ends. Your space begins.
